You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
Memory: one remembered fact per line, with the dates it held and the note that recorded it. An indented "earlier" line is a version of the fact above it that was later corrected.

- [decision] Decision: billing-api will gate the new invoice flow behind feature-flags, because the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch (since 2025-09-30; source standup/atlas/2025-09-30)
- [observation] Atlas noticed that the ledger's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change (since 2026-04-16; source standup/atlas/2026-04-16)
- [constraint] No deploys to the ledger from 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-03 because of the fiscal year close (since 2026-03-11; source standup/cinder/2026-03-11)
- Billing-api depends on feature-flags (since 2025-09-30; source standup/atlas/2025-09-30)
- [observation] Ember noticed that billing-api's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send (since 2025-11-04; source standup/ember/2025-11-04)
- [constraint] Changes to auth-gateway need two reviewer approvals and a security sign-off (since 2025-07-29; source standup/ember/2025-07-29)
- [observation] Atlas noticed that reporting's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change (since 2025-12-25; source standup/atlas/2025-12-25)

- [decision] Decision: reporting will read from the event-bus instead of querying the ledger directly, because the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs (since 2025-09-23; source standup/dune/2025-09-23)
- [constraint] Changes to billing-api need a rollback plan attached to the pull request (since 2025-04-02; source standup/ember/2025-04-02)
- Billing-api depends on the ledger (since 2025-01-09; source standup/atlas/2025-01-09-2)
- The handover note of 2025-06-09 wrongly recorded Boreal as the owner of billing-api (since 2025-07-03; source handover/2025-07-03-billing-api-correction)
- [constraint] Billing-api deploys only on weekdays after 15:00 UTC (since 2025-02-11; source standup/atlas/2025-02-11)
- [observation] Atlas noticed that webhooks's request volume halved after the client rollout (since 2026-04-08; source standup/atlas/2026-04-08)
- [observation] Ember noticed that the ledger's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy (since 2026-05-28; source standup/ember/2026-05-28)
- [decision] Decision: the scheduler leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds, because two leaders ran the nightly jobs twice in INC-2026-009 (since 2026-05-19; source incident-review/INC-2026-009)
